explanation: Italian nobles played tarocchi, a trick-taking game with trump cards. Using tarot to tell fortunes spread from France only in the late 18th century, and tarot card games are still played in France.

claims.text: Tarot cards were created in 15th-century Italy to play a trick-taking card game, tarocchi.
Tarot cards were not first made for telling fortunes, teaching scripture or keeping accounts.
The use of tarot cards for fortune-telling spread from France in the late 18th century.
Card games played with tarot decks are popular in France.

issues.note: In the 15th century the cards and game were called trionfi; the name tarocchi appears around 1500. 'The game later called tarocchi' would be exact.
